# select_team (Resource)

A team in the organization. A team groups users and SSO groups, so that a role granted to the team applies to all of its members.

## About

A team groups users and SSO groups. A role granted to a team applies to every member of the team. Add members with `select_team_member`. To refer to a team that Terraform does not manage, such as the built-in all-users team, use the `select_team` data source.

This resource is backed by SELECT's v2 API, at `/v2/teams`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A team whose new members are viewers unless the member says otherwise.
resource "select_team" "data_engineering" {
  name                = "Data Engineering"
  default_member_role = "viewer"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the team.

### Optional

- `default_member_role` (String) The default role for members added to this team: `admin`, `editor` or `viewer`. Defaults to `editor`. `select_team_member` always sends its own `role`, so this default does not apply to the members Terraform adds.
- `is_all_users` (Boolean) Whether the team automatically includes every organization member. Defaults to `false`.

### Read-Only

- `create_time` (String) When the team was created — RFC 3339 UTC, e.g. 2026-06-05T10:30:00Z.
- `etag` (String) Opaque strong ETag for this team. Sent as `If-Match` on updates and deletes so a change made outside Terraform cannot be silently overwritten.
- `id` (String) The team's identifier in SELECT, assigned when it is created. Use it with `terraform import` to bring an existing team under management.
- `update_time` (String) When the team was last updated — RFC 3339 UTC.

## Import

`select_team` can be imported using the team's ID in SELECT:

```bash
terraform import select_team.example 2f0899e2-2746-4300-887c-524e64b5a138
```

To find the ID, list the teams with the API:

```bash
curl -s https://api.select.dev/v2/teams \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SELECT_API_KEY" \
  -H "x-tenant-id: $SELECT_ORGANIZATION_ID" | jq '.items[] | {id, name}'
```

## Additional Information

### Changes made outside Terraform

Every write carries the team's `etag` as an `If-Match` header, so an update or delete is refused if the team changed since Terraform last read it. When that happens, run `terraform apply -refresh-only` to pick up the current state and then apply again.

### Deleting a team also deletes its members and role grants

Destroying this resource removes the team, every membership on it and every role granted to it. The users and SSO groups themselves are not changed.
